records.product: CHIRPS v2 quasi-global precipitation (0.05 deg, daily/pentad/monthly)
records.license_attribution: Per CHC CHIRPS data use policy (public dataset).
known_limitations: Daily accumulation window semantics are product-version dependent (v2 time coordinate = start of UTC day per ERDDAP; v3 ~00-24 UTC). Never convert daily values into arbitrary cutoffs silently.
prelim product has a ~2-day lag and uses GTS + Conagua stations only.
IR %CCD gaps over parts of E Australia/Indonesia/Japan can read as zero precipitation (coverage check required, not a fill).

records.access_reference: Copernicus Climate Data Store (CDS). DOI 10.24381/cds.e2161bac (verified Phase 2.3). No download endpoint is hardcoded; use the CDS API with registered credentials.
known_limitations: Preserve variable names, units and aggregation semantics: soil moisture / 2m temperature are instantaneous; precipitation accumulations are 00 UTC to step end.
The consolidated archive lags ~2 months; use ERA5-Land-T (~5 days) for near-real-time.
Publication/availability gate must be applied per vintage; do not create cutoff-ready features here.

notes: Acquisition ledger (Phase 3.2). One record per actual retrieval attempt (downloaded, skipped_existing, checksum_mismatch, failed) for DEMO and REAL acquisition events.

Raw bytes are stored under data/raw/real/ (git-ignored) with immutable filenames and SHA-256; this ledger is committed metadata only.

Phase 3.4 (2026-10-08): first live nasa-imerg-early attempt. Directory listings and URS token-list API authenticated (HTTP 200); V07C granules exist for day 281 (2026-10-08). Granule file download enforces URS bearer-token file access; token minting via POST https://urs.earthdata.nasa.gov/api/users/tokens returned the Earthdata Login HTML page (not JSON) in this environment, so no file artifact was acquired. Verdict: IMERG_LIVE_PREFLIGHT_FAILED. No substitute source was used.

Phase 3.5 (2026-10-08): first live chirps acquisition. Provider verified on 2026-10-08: daily v2 files are gzip TIFFs under products/CHIRPS-2.0/global_daily/tifs/p05/<year>/ on https://data.chc.ucsb.edu (HTTP GET 200, Content-Length matches FTP). Latest FINAL daily available was 2026-08-31 (month-ahead publication cadence). Acquired and validated chirps-v2.0.2026.08.31.tif.gz (10,288,665 B, SHA-256 44934651...): float32 GeoTIFF 7200x2000, EPSG:4326, 0.05 deg, -9999 fill, NE-India window 171x191 px, 4.6% fill, 0..186.0 mm, mean 19.2 mm. Supersedes the earlier note that no REAL artifact had been acquired: the REAL acquired count is now 1.

Phase 3.6 (2026-10-08): era5-land blocked at the CDS authentication gate. Provider/product were verified live from official CDS metadata on 2026-10-08: dataset reanalysis-era5-land (DOI 10.24381/cds.e2161bac), ERA5-Land hourly 1950-present, 0.1-degree lat/lon global grid, 60 verified variables, hourly time steps, bounded area subsetting (min 0.1 deg), GRIB or NetCDF4-experimental, CC-BY-4.0 licence; CDS execution API /api/retrieve/v1/jobs returns 401 unauthenticated (Personal Access Token required). The registry source requires CDS_API_URL + CDS_API_KEY; neither variable is configured in any env/.env, so resolve_credentials raised CredentialsMissingError and no network call, byte or record resulted. Verdict: ERA5_LAND_LIVE_PREFLIGHT_FAILED (authentication). No substitute source was used; CHIRPS record untouched.

Phase 3.6 (2026-10-08): first live era5-land (CDS) acquisition recorded. CDS async flow implemented in backend/app/services/cds.py (submit->poll->results->download, PRIVATE-TOKEN auth) and AcquisitionDriver.acquire_cds. Job 4548c91f-9c24-48c3-8e55-12c4ab786ae6 successful; 4 earlier attempts honestly recorded failed (1x HTTP 422 request-body format fix, 3x HTTP 403 licence gate before account-level acceptance). Artifact data/raw/real/era5-land/era5-land__operational-consolidated-2-months-era5-land-t-5-days__2026-07-15t0000.nc 127970 B sha256 af53a81a84460ab9abaf209f4535584e4c85404dbbb89b39e06db8f9c0824ac9. Pre-commit validation: readable NetCDF (CDS short names t2m/tp/swvl1/sro for 2m_temperature/total_precipitation/volumetric_soil_water_layer_1/surface_runoff; units K/m/m3.m-3/m); valid_time 2026-07-15T00:00Z; lat 21.0-29.5 step 0.1 (86), lon 88.0-97.5 step 0.1 (96); EPSG:4326. Four-time semantics: observation 2026-07-15 00:00-01:00Z, available 2026-09-15T00:00Z (DERIVED conservative bound; CDS exposes no per-vintage availability timestamp; consolidated ~2 months per registry), retrieved 2026-10-08T11:09:48Z, acquired 2026-10-08T11:09:48Z. Both observation and available precede the prediction window used today. REAL acquired count is now 2; no IMERG retry this phase (external gate).
